_doc: Building small things with your own hands on the street map (systems/handBuilding.js the model; world/innerMap/handBuilding.js the ground, the laying and the standing; ui/innerMapHandBuild.js the Build by Hand mode, the work and the drawing). Only on ground that is yours: your building lot in town (every cell of it), the ground within ground.aroundHome cells of a building you own (a house, a property, a home on its lot — in town or out in the wilds), every cell of a wilds hex whose estate you hold, or within ground.campRadius cells of the camp you staked on a wilds map (one a hex, never on another holder's estate, never in a town). Laying a structure stakes a site (stakes and string; its cells block from the first stake). You build it yourself: stand beside it and Work on It. Each piece of work is work.chunkSeconds of swinging (a real time) for work.chunkMinutes on the clock; a stage's goods come out of your packs as you start it (needs, by good id) and its hours of work (hours) are done at speed = toolSpeed when you carry any of work.toolGoods x (1 + hands.perHandSpeed x hands hired today). A stage done shows: frame, then walls, then roof. Work stops at work.lateHour, when you walk off, or when the next stage's goods are not in your packs. hands: townsfolk hired for the day at the nearest town's land wage x hands.wageMult (coin from your purse into the town's), at most hands.max; they work beside you and only while you do. Finished structures are kept on world.handBuilt[hex] (saved) and stand again each time the map is entered: a structure with a prop stands as that town prop (a fence joined to its neighbours, a gate that opens and shuts as every gate does and is kept in world.gates, the woodpile, the bough lean-to, the well); the others are drawn by hand (shed, hen coop, stone wall, scarecrow, signpost, bench). store: goods it holds (capacity units, goods: only those; none listed: any good). room: head of livestock room it adds to a place of yours on the same hex (systems/livestock.js), species it opens there. guard: a scarecrow's yield bonus (share) for your crops within guardReach cells (systems/crops.js harvest). seat: comfort and fun a sit on it gives, minutes it takes. water: a well is water to carry from for your crops (ui/innerMapFarming.js waterDistance). Dismantling takes dismantle.hoursShare of its build hours and gives back dismantle.finishedShare of the goods its stages took (a site: siteShare); a store must be empty first.

fence.name: Fence
fence.desc: A length of post-and-rail fence. Lay a run of them; with a gate they make a pen.

gate.name: Gate
gate.desc: A hung gate in your fence: open it, shut it; it stays as you leave it.

stone_wall.name: Stone Wall
stone_wall.desc: A length of dry-stone wall, knee high. Slow to raise and it outlasts you.

woodpile.name: Woodpile
woodpile.desc: A stacked woodpile between stakes: keeps your wood and firewood out of your packs.

lean_to.name: Bough Lean-to
lean_to.desc: Poles, boughs and reed thatch: a dry corner to keep things in, out in the wilds or behind the house.

shed.name: Wooden Shed
shed.desc: A plank shed with a door and a reed roof: a lockless store for whatever you like.

coop.name: Hen Coop
coop.desc: A raised coop with a ladder and nest boxes: room for more hens and ducks at a place of yours here.

well.name: Well
well.desc: Dig down to the water, line the shaft, raise the head and the winch. Long, hard work: water at your door for good.

scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
scarecrow.desc: A cross of poles in an old coat, stuffed with reeds: the birds keep off your crops nearby.

signpost.name: Signpost
signpost.desc: A post and a painted board with your House's name on it, for all who pass to read.

bench.name: Bench
bench.desc: A plank bench on two stumps: sit a while and watch the street.
